description: Forest Drought Risk Assessment Tool is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. Forest Drought Risk Assessment Tool (ForDRAT) provides estimates of stand-level drought risk for various BC tree species (Interior only at this point). Drought risk estimates are provided across different biogeoclimatic units and relative soil moisture regimes for both current and future climates. The data are currently provided in a spreadsheet, with the following columns: 1. Coverage: Government of British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. Its tags are Climate, Drought, Soil Moisture, Government information, Climat. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, HTML. The portal shows 2026-01-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
